book.title: Orooka o lebo ka Luka wele

content: Mariya ka ngmeng Yeso apeng Baitalami
A nyimi tomore tome, Ogomo ogong o Roma Kaisar Agustas waya ogomo ogong a pate makeke ma Roma wa ote o bena a bale pate aromo aka neya nyimi togomo te Roma.
(Aya a balo o bora a were e ka Kiriniyas wa ya togomo a makeke ma Suriya.)
Na aromo a pate ne kuri a topepeng to ne adorana a bale ne.

A Yusupu wa ere apeng Nazarat a nyimi makeke ma Galili na wa ale apeng Baitalami a makeke ma Yahudiya, araaka a ngmeng ogomo Daoda ne. Yusupu wa ale saname aza o bekaana ne abuudu ayende ai ka na Daoda
Wa ale ka Mariya kando kamea wa ya caasa me a kaye ka etumǝ, adorana a bale ne.
A were aka neya Baitalami, na tomore to ngmenga kai toye,
naka ngmeng kena ka kai ka o bora. Naka urǝ kai ka majembele aka nata kai a nyimi o onggo o nyaza emande epaolya, aza o bena a dera odo akwilǝ ageng.
Atoma o suri a Ashili ne suria nyimi ana o tare ka emande
A ana o tare ka emande epeng ya za o eza ogole one a lelyaare o wake a ma'amo ka apeng a Baitalami.
Na otoma o surǝ a zaa shili wa suri a nyimi one, a masanto ma Ashili ma malmi a nyimi one, nane kala o ara o kona boome.
Na otoma Ashili o zaa shili bekaa ne na, “Tane kone boome ne. Ma ca ying oroka o lebo, omea wayo ote aromo a pate kane kone o leba.
O ngmeengme na, a nyimi apeng a Daoda, a ngmenga ondo boza o ying Ondooka Ashili a zake
Ateokora.
Enna eyo itǝ aying epa o kabare, eyo mana kena a pate a nyimi majembele kanza a nata kai a nyimi o onggo.”
A saseya na leguki le atoma a Ashili o zaa shili ne suri. Ane mana oyende name, nane saba Ashili ane beye na,

content.text: o cikǝ o cammo wa itǝ ka andaaka

content: Nangka Atoma Ashili o zaa shili ne kuri ba zaa shili ane baya ne, na ana o tare ka emande me bekaa tokpwe to ne na, “Era na nanname ka ale o Baitalami ka laka epa eka Ateokora wa bele ro.”
Nyimia ne ere a saseya nane mana Mariya ka Yusupu, ka kena kame ane nata kai a nyimi o onggo.
Nangka ana o tare ka emande me ne laka kai, nane baale epa eka otoma Ashili o zaa shili wa bele ne ba zaa kena kame.
Pate aromo ka ne kone oroka me, na epa eme tere ne okpwe ba za epa eka ana o tare ka emande ne bele ne.
Na Mariya onte pate epa eka a beya a lenyong le kai.
Ana o tare ka emande me ne kuri, ane beye leera ane saba Ashili, aza epa eka ne kona ka e epa eka ne laka. Nane eze keeya nangka otoma Ashili o zaa shili wa bele ne.
O niyi Yeso akwilǝ Ashili
A lengme lo riiru, na core kena kame, a nya kai leze na Yeso, leze lee mea otoma Ashili o zaa shili wa nya a ta aya e tumǝ kai ne.
Nangka a were o kwizǝ madinǝ ma iini me nangka maYahuda ezeze wa ye na Mariya ka Yusupu ne ale ka Yeso apeng Urushalima adorana a niyi kai ba Ateokora, nangka angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa a beke.
Nyimia a wele ba ngmǝ a Ateokora, “Pate kena ka lome ko bora kamea a ngmenga a yo beya kai na kena ka sangsang ka Ateokora.”
Nane core egoma leere o wore bekaana ne tare e epa eka angmǝ a Ateokora a beke o kwizǝ madinǝ ma iini.

A were me ondaleme yende wa zene apeng a Urushalima ka a beya wai na Siman. Wa ya sangsang lenyong, a wa tare Ashili, kanza wa ya zaa o enda lengme leeka a yo boza aromo a Yahuda. A obere Ashili wa tare ka wai.
Na obere Ashili me wa bekaa wai na wato gbwǝ ne seeka wa laka Ondooka Ashili a zake oka Ateokora wa tong.
O bero o sangsang me wa tare ka wai na wa lyǝ atatara akwilǝ Ashili, ba were name iini ka ate a Yeso ne de ka kai kane eze e epa eka angmǝ Ashili a beke na ne eze.
Na Siman ana kena kame ba taara te wai a wa saba Ashili, a wa beyana,

content.text: ka a yizi ang ma laka ondo o boza,
nangka ba beka, baya ozara o wa ale a cammo.
Ondo boza ona ka ba nya
masanto ma o pari a yizi aworme
kanza ka o sana aromo au maYahuda.”

content: Na epa eme tere okpwe ate ka iini kena kame aza epa eka a bekaa ba za kena kame.

A Siman me bekaa angmǝ lebo aza one, a wa bekaa Mariya iini kena kame na, “Ashili a Zaka kena kaana ka ka itǝ orona o rizi andaaka ne nyana kai ka o boza ona ondo ba cake a Yahuda aka ne emba kai, kanza wa itǝ e epa eka aromo a cake neto yeme ne.
Aza nyimi a yo bangali madoola ma nyongnga cake. Bo ma Mariya oyo kona a kpwaiye na o sagali wa donga lenyong leo.”
Kando ka o beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili ka rene kanza, ka a beya kai na Hanatu, ongmenga Panuel ka abuudu ana Ashiru, ka ka she ong. Ka cikǝ ka ondaleme kai shenai sondaare malome a wa gbwi,
nyimia ka cikǝ legbwǝri shenai tuuru riiru ka se naaze. Ka ta ka tukǝ baya akwilǝ Ashili ne lelyaare ka letereme aza o gera mainu ma Ashili, ka pateze ongmǝ aka beeze angmǝ ka Ashili.
Ka o deya kai ane a were name, naka wore o leba kai ba Ashili a ka beke angmǝ ba za kena kame andaaka neya soola o boza pate aromo a Urushalima.
Nangka Yusupu ka Mariya ne mare pate epa eka angmǝ a Ateokora beke, ane kuri apeng ane Narazat a makeke ma Galili.
Na kena kame ka gong a kaye legoone, a Ashili tare ka kai a nyimi o rosa, a masanto ma Ashili ma ya zaa o kai.
A gere Yeso na cǝ kai akwilǝ Ashili
Koonang lenai a ate ka iini Yeso ne aleze ba Urushalima aza o gwarnang o rintǝ o surǝ maYahuda a makeke ma Masar.
A were oka Yeso ka dukǝ shenai betuuru ka se leere, nane ale ka kai a gwarnang name nangka makili mane maze.
Nangka ne mare o gwarnang ome, aneya orona o kurǝ akwilǝ ane apeng Nazarat, na Yeso kena ka itǝ a dimǝ a Urushalima, ana ate ka iini kai ta rosa ne.
Neya madoola ma o bekaana kaye legwa ka ne, nane were a teweno. Malo nyimia nane bore o gera kai ba nyimi arone ane ka ajaa kai.
Nangka neta ne laka kai ne, nane kuri ba Urushalima a gera kai.
Malo tomore to taaro nane cǝ kai ba nyimi atatara akwilǝ Ashili, aka ya cikǝ a tera ana o baala ngmǝ Ashili, aka ya konaza aka kang eza ne be pirǝ.
Pate ondooka wa kone kai na epa eme tǝru a wai a lenyong aza o rosa kai ka nangka ka kabareze.
Nangka ate ka iini Yeso ne laka kai, nane kerke ko kona o leba. Na iini kai bekaa kai na, “Kena, eyaka baya ro nanna? Me ka ate au te zitǝ a gera o.”
Naka pirkǝ ne na, “Eyaka eya gera ong? Eta rosa o bena ma era anta arnang ka kwilǝ ate ang ne na?”
Nane ta rosa epa eka ka ya beya me ne.
Naka kuri apeng a Nazarat kaa ne aka tare ngmǝ ane. A iini kai onte pate epaname a lenyong le kai.
Na Yeso gongnga a lepung, ka o rosa o cak, kanza a Ashili ka aromo yeme kai.

footnotes.text: Ondooka Ashili a zake ondo boza ka Ashili atong.
